Peso Pluma's birth name is **Hassan Emilio Kabande Laija**.

Claims and support:

- Peso Pluma was born Hassan Emilio Kabande Laija. Wikipedia's article on the artist states this, and the search results for that name agree.
  https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peso_Pluma
- He was born on 15 June 1999 in Zapopan, Jalisco, Mexico. This comes from the Wikipedia page. A secondary source (Sportskeeda) says Guadalajara, but Zapopan is part of the Guadalajara metropolitan area, so the two don't really conflict.
  https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peso_Pluma
  https://wiki.sportskeeda.com/youtube/where-is-peso-pluma-from

Caveat: I read the Wikipedia page only up to its first 100,000 characters, and the search snippets came from secondary sources. I didn't check a primary source such as a birth record. The name appears consistently across the sources I saw.
